_note: Episode 2 version 2 (the new form). Every still is one full painted picture in the Bakunawa look (the JSON prompt of pipeline/draw_pick.py, drawn one request at a time: three draws a key, the choice at 3x). Writing in pictures is added in code after the choice (pipeline/sign_text.py). The silent shot 37 (the grandmother's hand) is shown under sentence 96. bk_46, bk_47, bk_48, bk_49, bk_50, bk_51, bk_52 are second stills where one row of shots.md holds several beats. Camera moves and their reasons are in shots_fx.json ("why"), from the Camera column of shots.md (pipeline/CAMERA.md).

bk_43.subject: Rack-focus shot: at the right of the upper half of the picture, sharp and close, a plain black smartphone, its screen plain glowing white with nothing on it, propped upright on the stone parapet; far behind it on the other side of the grassy bastion, small and out of focus, an open red umbrella, no figure visible under it. No people, no hands, no dog. The top-left corner is only dusk sky. The lower half of the picture is only weathered stone.
bk_43.setting: the wide grass-topped top of an old round Spanish stone bastion of Intramuros, Manila, in our time: weathered grey-brown volcanic stone walls, low stone parapets, a green lawn, stone paths, acacia trees
bk_43.light: deep orange and purple-blue dusk, the last sun on the stone, long shadows, cool air, rim light, the red of the umbrella the one warm spot far away, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork.
bk_43.note: First sight of M: only the umbrella. Rack focus from the phone to the umbrella (focus_to far).

bk_44.subject: Still close shot: the empty brown paper bag with a strip of dark red and indigo striped handwoven cloth knotted round its top, standing alone on top of a low stone parapet in the middle of the picture; the upper third of the picture only empty deep blue sky. No people, no hands, no dog, no animals. The lower half of the picture is only dark stone.
bk_44.setting: the wide grass-topped top of an old round Spanish stone bastion of Intramuros, Manila, in our time: weathered grey-brown volcanic stone walls, low stone parapets, a green lawn, stone paths, acacia trees
bk_44.light: deep blue nightfall, a last orange line on the horizon, soft warm glow on the stone, rim light, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork.
bk_44.note: s92 is about 6.5 s: ONE continuous hold (slow push), the question in code, no second still.
